subject: Error message with summary() for averaged home range

messages.author: 7324f87aaa1afb0b
messages.subject: Error message with summary() for averaged home range
parts:
Hi Chris,
I'm running some code from a year ago and with the averaged home ranges (for "seasons" within year) I get the following error with the summary() call.

> summary(x) #95% Kernel area

Error in if (type != "range") { : argument is of length zero

> summary(x, level.UD=0.50) #50% Kernel Core area

Error in if (type != "range") { : argument is of length zero

Looking through some old threads here I tried the development version you linked (devtools::install_github("ctmm-initiative/ctmm")) but that didn't work. The UD plots fine (two disjunct polygons), the issue is just with the summary() call. A bit more of my code is provided below. I appreciate the help.

Ross


#Fit models for both home range segments simultaneously

GUESS <- lapply(CLEFT[1:2], function(b) ctmm.guess(b,interactive=FALSE) )

FITS <- lapply(1:2, function(i) ctmm.select(CLEFT[[i]],GUESS[[i]]) )

names(FITS) <- names(CLEFT[1:2])


# Gaussian overlap between both seasonal periods

overlap(FITS)


# AKDE overlap between both seasonal periods

# create aligned UDs


dr <- c(1,1) #Sets grid resolution of Utilization Distribution

UDS <- akde(CLEFT[1:2], FITS, weights=TRUE, fast=FALSE, grid=dr)

plot(UDS)



# evaluate overlap

overlap(UDS)


#average home ranges

x <-mean(UDS, weights=c(1,3))


#plot and summary statistics

plot(tortoise155.16, UD=x)


summary(x) #95% Kernel area

summary(x, level.UD=0.50) #50% Kernel Core area

Sorry about that error. I made an update to make the consistent grid calculations more memory efficient. This should be fixed on GitHub now.

Best,
Chris
